description: Rewrites only the translation line of examples that already exist on Lingard cards; the example sentence, its {} highlights and its audio/typing markers are left exactly as they are. It changes, adds, or removes example translations; an empty translation is a supported card state, not an error. `translations` holds one entry per existing example, in order, so it is built from the card's current examples (a collection read with includeExamples:true lists them). commit=true writes; without it the call returns the resulting examples as a preview.

cards.description: One entry per card to edit. Each entry needs a card selector (`cardId`, or `title` plus a collection when the word occurs in several) and `translations`.

cardId.description: Card selector (preferred): the card's cardId, as listed with the collection's cards.

title.description: Card selector (alternative to `cardId`): the word on the card.

translations.description: Positional: entry N replaces the translation line of example N, and a shorter list leaves the remaining examples untouched. Use "" or null to leave an example untranslated (this is allowed and is how a user clears a translation), or {"index":2,"t":"…"} to patch a single example. The example text itself is never read from here.

collectionTitle.description: Optional default collection title for cards addressed by title.

collectionUuid.description: Optional default collection for cards addressed by title.

commit.description: True writes. Default false returns the resulting examples without saving.

name: lingard_update_example_translations

examples.description: The card examples as they stand after the update, example text unchanged.

c.description: Example sentence in the target language, with the target word wrapped in {}.

e.description: Whether the example is enabled on the card.

t.description: Translation line, or null when the example is deliberately left untranslated.

updatedExamples.description: Indexes of the examples whose translation line changed.

title: Update Lingard Example Translations
